Additional property is not available in order to have contiguous boundaries. It is to be noted that no significant changes in physical effects on the school land users is expected because none of the land to be acquired from the school will be used for highway purposes. Instead the land will be used to replace parkways sidewalks and a pedastrian underpass. It is to be noted that a park serving the same activities is available approximately two (2) blocks away and that the new pedestrian overpass will facilitate access to that park.
